epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a flock of cedar waxwings who have taken over the centers aviary and are keeping the staff busy with endless demands for food. Then the rescue team works with the Ministry of Natural Resources to relocate a coyote thats too people-friendly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集動物朋友仔有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在納米比亞中部,一群非洲野犬在乾旱的土地上漫遊.受到獅子和乾旱兩面夾擊,一隻名為賴卡的勇敢幼崽必須快速成長,學習獵人的技能,並找到自己在族群中的定位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非的大克魯格國家公園,一頭名為青加的幼崽出生在馬啦馬啦獅群這個獵人世家中.在忠實的父親,嚴母和淘氣的姐姐指導下,青加找到她在族群中的定位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In South Africas Greater Kruger Park, A little cub called Chiga has been born into family of hunters - the Mala Mala lion pride. Under the guidance of a devoted father, a fierce mother, and a playful sister, Chiga finds her place in the pride.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小獵豹烏珊娜生長在不利環境中.很少小獵豹能夠撐過一歲.但她很幸運,有一位厲害的母親,她會不惜一切保護幼崽安全.烏珊娜只需跟隨她的腳步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, shes got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西卡皮瓦拉山脈國家公園裡,小卷尾猴施高正學習如何融入規則複雜的族群,並探索充滿刺激和危機處處的森林.但純熟地掌控工具才是他的生存關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Brazils Serra da Capivara, Chico, the baby capuchin monkey is learning to integrate into a troop with complicated rules, and exploring a forest full of excitement and danger. But mastering the art of tool use holds the key to his survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度,年幼獅尾猴華菲面對著不斷縮小的棲息地和人類世界的侵擾.幸運的是,他有一位慈母,一位防範的父親,一位淘氣的姐姐,以及眾多親戚都在看顧他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In India, Ravi the baby lion-tailed macaque faces life in a shrinking habitat and encroaching human world. Luckily he has a caring mum, a protective dad, a playful sister, and numerous, cousins, aunts and uncles all watching over him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?秘「蜜」日記講述這個故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在海陸相連的公園中,自然元素相互結合,創造出美妙的多樣性.可樂色的水使森林變得翠綠和茂密.火與風促進多樣性的增長,岩石形成了眾多面貌的海岸線.生命在這裡茁壯成長 - 從壯麗到奇異,這是花園大道國家公園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here -...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水.在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線.它是不論大小所有生物的生命線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. Its a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布.奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word oukurubes which means place of thunder in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物,水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長.所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功...這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africas greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey i...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區.南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護.在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19t...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​追溯獅子從史前掠食者到現代統治者的崛起,隨著科學揭示塑造這位標誌性非洲獵手的戰鬥,聯繫和殘酷生存策略.沉浸在獅子社會的戲劇和高風險狩獵的情節中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對海洋中最具多樣性和威脅性的掠食者.了解幫助這種史前物種在多次大規模滅絕中生存下來的生物優勢,然後驚嘆於公牛鯊無情的狩獵技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​重溫棕熊的進化之旅,從主宰冰河時期的熊科祖先到今天的現代雜食動物.見證它們與鮭魚之間的共生關係,以及它們所繁榮的驚人互聯生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨黑犀牛的旅程,看看適應和保護如何影響這位古老自然巨人的進化.體驗這種裝甲草食動物的非凡聽力,嗅覺和其他生物優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在整個非洲,97%的黑犀牛因其角而被殺死.1997年,該物種在尚比亞被宣布正式絕種.但現在,由於雄心勃勃的重新引入計劃,牠們又回來了.偷獵並沒有消失 - 牠們的角在亞洲醫藥中仍然很珍貴.但一個專責小組正在努力保護牠們的安全.這是保育的前線 - 但它前所未有地困難.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, theyre back. Poaching hasnt gone away – their horns are still...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是尚比亞兩隻黑犀牛的關鍵時刻. 四歲的雌性押臣和十四歲的公牛肯高是複雜的重置任務的核心,這是宏偉的拯救物種計劃的一部分.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a critical time for two black rhinos in Zambia. Four year old female Apson and fourteen year old bull Kango are at the core of a complex relocation mission thats part of a grand plan to save a species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在尚比亞最大和最野生的保護區卡富埃國家公園深處,來自「尚比亞肉食性動物計劃」的生物學家和獸醫團隊爭分奪秒地拯救和保護非洲的頂級掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in Kafue National Park, the largest and wildest protected area in Zambia, a team of biologists and vets from the Zambian Carnivore Programme (ZCP) races against time to save and protect Africas apex predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩.當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動.每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the rescue team for a madcap chase after a red-tailed hawk. He may be unable to fly, but he sure can run! Then follow the recovery of a rare albino squirrel who cant walk, and see how the medical team ensures hell be ready for the wild again.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,包括「牧場經理」巴克萊,一頭恰巧是馴馬天才的大丹犬.在非洲,一隻名為「雷神」的小狨猴迷戀兩隻年青獲救的獴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including ranch manager Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獅尾狒是一種稀有的猴子,只棲居於埃塞俄比亞塞米恩山脈之中,他們富有魅力,愛發出聲音,並經常處於熱情和對抗之間.觀察牠們如何面對棲息地萎縮的挑戰--以及彼此之間的鬥爭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. Theyre charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitat-and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 進入南非的荒野,近距離觀察這個大陸最容易被誤解的靈長類動物之一.跟人類一樣,這些靈長類動物具有獨特的個性,與家人和朋友都有著強烈的聯繫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continents most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨着人類的活動範圍不斷擴張,非洲的狒狒必須適應求存.走訪整個非洲大陸,觀察牠們如何在面對家族存亡的關鍵時刻,形成牢不可破的社群連繫,並在不斷變化的環境中掙扎求存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As humans take up more space, the baboons of Africa must adapt. Travel across the continent to watch them form unbreakable social bonds, serve to protect their families and survive a changing landscape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在坦桑尼亞海岸青翠的桑給巴爾島上,生活著一家紅疣猴.牠們是同類中僅存的一夥,被困在一個萎縮的天堂裡.在人口不斷增長的壓力下,他們稱牠們為「毒猴」,而且森林被外來物種入侵.如果小葉猴要適應牠的新世界,將需要新技巧和父母的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Off the coast of Tanzania, baby Kima lives with his family of red Colobus monkeys. But what happens when he loses his way? Discover how this little monkey learns to adapt to life in the jungle-and find out if he can reconnect with his family again.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥倫比亞海岸奇觀 第一季 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 戈爾戈納島是一個哥倫比亞偏遠的島嶼,它有一個黑暗的秘密.這是一個天然堡壘,周圍海域被鯊魚環繞著,又被無法穿透的叢林覆蓋,並充滿致命的毒蛇.因此,它成為政府監獄的選址.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gorgona was once home to Colombias Alcatraz. Modelled on Nazi concentration camps, prisoners dreamt of escape. See the islands stunning wildlife through the eyes of a convict on the run, the monkeys, snakes and sloths whove now reclaimed the land.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥倫比亞海岸奇觀 第一季 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在距離哥倫比亞大西洋沿岸400英里的加勒比海普羅維登斯島上,一隻年輕的雌性黑蟹即將開展她生命中最重要的任務; 在距離海岸2英里的徒步旅行中,從她山頂的家中護送她那8萬粒卵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the island of Providencia, a black crab begins the mission of her life, escorting 80,000 eggs from her home, on a 3 km hike to the coast. Join her, and millions of her clan, on a journey fraught with danger, where chances of survival are slim.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 處理爭鬥的小鴨圍捕,看看獸醫卡琳娜 (Karina) 是否會請專家來治療考拉斯派克 (Spike) 的腿部骨折.深入了解困擾針鼴寶寶乒 (Ping) 和乓 (Pong) 的胃病問題,並遇到了似乎迷路了的考拉賈拉 (Jarrah).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spikes leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與大量被遺棄的考拉幼崽打交道,隨後與獸醫護士尼克 (Nick) 一起尋找治療小袋鼠腸道疾病的天然藥物.思考如何解救被困在樹上的蝙蝠寶寶,並觀看獸醫卡琳娜為一隻翅膀骨折的倉鸮進行手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallabys gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owls fractured wing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛羅里達州以其沙質海岸而聞名 - 而且有很多地方可供參觀.佛羅里達擁有美國大陸任何一個州最多潮汐的海岸線.這些海濱遊樂場亦是受著威脅和瀕危物種的重要棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Florida is famous for its sandy shores-and theres plenty to go around. Florida has the most tidal shoreline of any state in the continental USA. These ocean-side playgrounds are also critical habitats for threatened and endangered species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在諾華斯高沙省的任何一個邊界,證明任何海灘都是由相反的原始力量所建成,但若生命要茁壯成長,這些力量之間的平衡也是必要的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At either edge of the province, Nova Scotia proves that any beach is built from raw forces in opposition, but also that balance between those forces is necessary if life is to thrive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 墨西哥尤卡坦半島是海龜和馬尾藻的家園,同時也是旅遊聖地;三者如何和諧共存?這個寶地可以持續發展嗎?揭開這個墨西哥海灘背後的秘密,包括每年舉行的一個古老分娩儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yucatán Peninsula is home to tourists, sea turtles, and sargassum seaweed. How do the three coexist in harmony? Is it sustainable? Uncover the secrets behind this Mexican beach, including an ancient birthing ritual that takes place each year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象傳奇有三個故事.一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲.一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶.一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠.這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非,春天在九月初顯現端倪,大自然生氣盎然.白晝漸長,氣溫升高.萬物復蘇,生機勃勃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是極端的季節,它劃分出了弱者與强者.它考驗著獵豹,獅子,壁虎,海龜和更多物種在酷熱的夏天尋找食物和水的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來了機遇.南非毛皮海豹,薩曼哥猴子,變色龍,黑斑羚和更多其他動物感應著季節的變化.秋天使許多動物的生活發生了變化.珍稀生物現身,食肉動物聚集起來獲取優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 親眼目睹冬天給非洲帶來的死亡和復活吧.從乾旱到寒風,觀察白晝的縮短會帶來什麼,並驚歎於動物和植物在面對季節的狂暴時的生存技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the seasons fury.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物之間的睡眠策略千變萬化,然而睡眠似乎是一種再普遍不過的行為.但究竟為何動物需要睡眠呢?它們如何應對無法休息或在野外昏迷可能帶來的危險?這些問題只是野生動物如何睡覺中的冰山一角.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象傳奇有三個故事.一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲.一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶.一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠.這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非,春天在九月初顯現端倪,大自然生氣盎然.白晝漸長,氣溫升高.萬物復蘇,生機勃勃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 討人喜歡,被視為滑稽的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂.長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖.少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夜間追蹤任務到救援行動,了解MH-6小鳥直昇機如何在其他大型機體中贏得一席之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From night stalker missions to rescue operations, see how the Little Bird helicopter earned its place among the big boys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長.深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮遊植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步.因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界.他能成功嗎? 第一站-倫敦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes』 Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努在倫敦之後來到杜拜,很快就在當地累積了豐富的煮食經驗,因此他出發前往香料市場,魚市場和當地的甜品廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu arrives in Dubai after London and is quick to dig up as much culinary experience in Dubai so he sets off to the spice souk, fish markets and a local pastry kitchen.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物.從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊.他能準時,完好無缺地到達香港嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu is in India for the first time in his life and wants to discover as much food as he can handle. From an Idli making lesson to a workout in the flower markets of Kolkata. Will he make it to Hong Kong on time and in one piece?

epg.programme_title_tc: 拉斐爾納達爾:紅土球王
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片深入探討網球傳奇拉斐爾納達爾的人生,探索他從神童成長為全球巨星的歷程.透過眾多勝利和挑戰揭示拿度在球場內外所貢獻的遺產.(V374)
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary delves into the life of tennis legend Rafael Nadal, exploring his journey from a young prodigy to a global icon. Through triumphs and challenges, it reveals the dedication that defines Nadal’s legacy on and off the court.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從小鎮天才到世界第一,這部紀錄片記錄了穆雷追求卓越的堅持,與傷病的搏鬥,以及他作為網壇最具啟發性人物之一的永恆傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town prodigy to World No. 1, Andy Murray: Game Set Match chronicles his relentless pursuit of greatness, his battles with injury, and his enduring legacy as one of tenniss most inspiring figures.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美,最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物,200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫南非美食之旅的第一站是繁華的開普敦.他在當地到訪熱鬧的農貿市場,並在 保卡烹調開普馬來咖哩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫沿著南非海岸角繼續他的美食之旅,在抵達大森林私人自然保護區前,先到訪卡耶利沙黑人區,那裡是一些具啟發性的微型農業提案的集中地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa’s Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片帶領觀眾深入且全面地回顧萊昂內爾・梅西的非凡職業生涯--從阿根廷羅薩裡奧的平凡起點,到成為全球足球傳奇巨星的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi - from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

epg.programme_title_tc: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員,導演和慈善家.從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性.這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called 「bubble feeding」 to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《博物館的秘密》帶觀眾深入倫敦 VA 博物館幕後,展出康斯特勃的版畫,桑迪・鮑威爾的簽名西裝,法貝熱的英國作品,以及由首位 Beano 女性藝術家蘿拉・豪威爾創作的新漫畫插圖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secrets of the Museum goes behind the scenes at the VA, featuring Constables prints, Sandy Powells autographed suit, Fabergés British works, and new Beano artwork by Laura Howell, the first female Beano artist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週於 VA 展出:一套為男裝展打造的粉紅亮片西裝,搬遷至東倫敦分館的羅賓漢花園十噸建築切片,青年館展示的仿生手臂,以及艾瑞克・拉維利斯的《旅行》茶具組.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week at the VA, a pink lamé suit for a menswear exhibit, a 10-tonne slice of Robin Hood Gardens for VA East, a bionic arm for Young VA, and Eric Raviliouss Travel tea set are featured.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夜間追蹤任務到救援行動,了解MH-6小鳥直昇機如何在其他大型機體中贏得一席之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From night stalker missions to rescue operations, see how the Little Bird helicopter earned its place among the big boys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoo’s five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態.從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal’s diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海.探索成年雄鹿,青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs spring rituals, and Grebes dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城普利托利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.programme_title_tc: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員,導演和慈善家.從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性.這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Clint Eastwood, Actor, director and philanthropist. From being the quintessential western icon, to honing his artistic skills and caring persona. This is his magnificent story.

epg.programme_title_tc: 瑪麗亞凱莉:毅力與魅力
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪麗亞.凱莉的人生宛如童話般的灰姑娘故事.至尊歌后,聖誕女王,熱心公益的慈善家--她已售出超過 2.2 億張唱片,並推出史上最暢銷的聖誕專輯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Cinderella story of sorts, Mariah Carey. Songbird Supreme. Queen of Christmas. Dedicated philanthropist. Mariah has sold over 220 million records and released the best-selling Christmas album ever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從地下俱樂部到全球巨星,《女神卡卡:為舞而生》探索這位重新定義音樂,時尚與名聲的流行偶像勢不可擋的崛起之路.在勝利與挫折交織的人生中,見證卡卡如何以舞步迎戰挑戰,並最終勝出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From underground clubs to global superstardom, Lady Gaga: Dance or Die explores the unstoppable rise of the pop icon who redefined music, fashion, and fame. Through triumphs and tribulations, witness how Gaga danced through life’s challenges - and wo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞,彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Bill Clintons complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭,其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Documentary examines George W. Bushs presidency, focusing on the Iraq War, its aftermath, and the lasting impact of his decisions, including the rise of ISIS and the human toll of the conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ronald Reagan, a charismatic leader, transformed America with Reaganomics, dividing opinion at home and abroad, and forever changing Conservatism with his visionary policies and iconic speeches.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫布頓體育館的榮譽委員會充滿了傑出的名字.在1998 年,又添一個.羅渣費達拿.從任何意義上來說,他登上男子比賽巔峰的旅程就是真正的冠軍之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wimbledon Stadium’s Honour Board is full of illustrious names. And in 1998, another emerged. Roger Federer. His journey to the top of the men’s game is the one of a true champion, in every sense of the word.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.programme_title_tc: 瑪麗亞凱莉:毅力與魅力
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪麗亞.凱莉的人生宛如童話般的灰姑娘故事.至尊歌后,聖誕女王,熱心公益的慈善家--她已售出超過 2.2 億張唱片,並推出史上最暢銷的聖誕專輯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Cinderella story of sorts, Mariah Carey. Songbird Supreme. Queen of Christmas. Dedicated philanthropist. Mariah has sold over 220 million records and released the best-selling Christmas album ever.

epg.programme_title_tc: 羅賓·威廉斯:笑容下的淚
epg.programme_title_en: Robin Williams: Laugh Until You Cry
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這位喜劇泰鬥有著令人驚嘆的頭腦,還有一系列讓我們嘖嘖稱奇的才華.他的故事激勵我們看穿那些看似擁有完美人生的人的面具. 他的精神將一直承傳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The comic genius with an electric mind, with a range of talent that left us breathless. His story inspires us to look past the mask of those people who seem to have a perfect life. His legacy lives on.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬修派瑞因飾演昌德賓一角而深受觀眾喜愛,作為一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人們通過強調他在片場內外的喜劇遺產和個人奮鬥的珍藏片段緬懷他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matthew Perry, beloved for his role as Chandler Bing, is remembered through archive footage highlighting his comedic legacy and personal struggles, both on and off set, as a cherished friend and human being.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夜間追蹤任務到救援行動,了解MH-6小鳥直昇機如何在其他大型機體中贏得一席之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From night stalker missions to rescue operations, see how the Little Bird helicopter earned its place among the big boys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞,彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Bill Clintons complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭,其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Documentary examines George W. Bushs presidency, focusing on the Iraq War, its aftermath, and the lasting impact of his decisions, including the rise of ISIS and the human toll of the conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ronald Reagan, a charismatic leader, transformed America with Reaganomics, dividing opinion at home and abroad, and forever changing Conservatism with his visionary policies and iconic speeches.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫布頓體育館的榮譽委員會充滿了傑出的名字.在1998 年,又添一個.羅渣費達拿.從任何意義上來說,他登上男子比賽巔峰的旅程就是真正的冠軍之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wimbledon Stadium’s Honour Board is full of illustrious names. And in 1998, another emerged. Roger Federer. His journey to the top of the men’s game is the one of a true champion, in every sense of the word.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步.因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界.他能成功嗎? 第一站-倫敦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu Feildel has a dream to follow in the footsteps of Jules Vernes』 Around the World in 80 days. So Manu sets himself a challenge to circumnavigate the world, through his food loving eyes. Will he make it? First stop - London.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努在倫敦之後來到杜拜,很快就在當地累積了豐富的煮食經驗,因此他出發前往香料市場,魚市場和當地的甜品廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu arrives in Dubai after London and is quick to dig up as much culinary experience in Dubai so he sets off to the spice souk, fish markets and a local pastry kitchen.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物.從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊.他能準時,完好無缺地到達香港嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu is in India for the first time in his life and wants to discover as much food as he can handle. From an Idli making lesson to a workout in the flower markets of Kolkata. Will he make it to Hong Kong on time and in one piece?

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努前往香港,這是他環球之旅的第四個國度,當然亦安排了一些極品美食之旅.雞腳,添好運,掃街以及許多適合他去日本東京前的適應活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu heads to Hong Kong, the fourth country on his around the world tour, and he has some great food excursions lined up. Chicken feet, Tim Ho Wan, street food and lots to fit in before he jumps across the pond to Tokyo, Japan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #5
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努的環球之旅已過一半,他前往探索繁華的東京.這是一個巨大的挑戰,因為在他正享受的同時,預算還有多少呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Manu heads past his halfway mark on his journey around the world, he heads to Tokyo to explore the bustling city. It is a massive challenge and he is having the time of his life but how is that budget going?

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是最後衝刺,馬努的名單只剩下一個國家.美國作為他冒險的最後一站提供了令人驚嘆的美食體驗.環遊世界.三十天.花費20,000美元.馬努能夢想成真嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is the home stretch with just one more country on Manus list. America offers amazing food experiences on his final leg of his adventure. Around the world. Thirty days. $20,000 to spend. Will Manu achieve his dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬修派瑞因飾演昌德賓一角而深受觀眾喜愛,作為一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人們通過強調他在片場內外的喜劇遺產和個人奮鬥的珍藏片段緬懷他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matthew Perry, beloved for his role as Chandler Bing, is remembered through archive footage highlighting his comedic legacy and personal struggles, both on and off set, as a cherished friend and human being.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬治・克隆尼以迷人外型與自然魅力聞名,但他的傳奇不僅止於銀幕.娛樂之外,他更是慈善與人道精神的代表人物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: George Clooney might be celebrated for his striking looks and effortless charisma, but his legacy goes far beyond the allure of Hollywood. Beyond entertainment, Clooney stands as a beacon of philanthropy.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到託斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #3

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚.當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called 「bubble feeding」 to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房.然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oons restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynts restaurant, Burnt Ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮.他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感.他教授了如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士,溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapores best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《博物館的秘密》帶觀眾深入倫敦 VA 博物館幕後,展出康斯特勃的版畫,桑迪・鮑威爾的簽名西裝,法貝熱的英國作品,以及由首位 Beano 女性藝術家蘿拉・豪威爾創作的新漫畫插圖.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secrets of the Museum goes behind the scenes at the VA, featuring Constables prints, Sandy Powells autographed suit, Fabergés British works, and new Beano artwork by Laura Howell, the first female Beano artist.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週於 VA 展出:一套為男裝展打造的粉紅亮片西裝,搬遷至東倫敦分館的羅賓漢花園十噸建築切片,青年館展示的仿生手臂,以及艾瑞克・拉維利斯的《旅行》茶具組.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week at the VA, a pink lamé suit for a menswear exhibit, a 10-tonne slice of Robin Hood Gardens for VA East, a bionic arm for Young VA, and Eric Raviliouss Travel tea set are featured.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客,一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. There’s room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison d』être. The police forces』 special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000臺風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.programme_title_en: Johnny Depp: The Art Of Transformation
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員,製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名.儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞臺上迎來強勢回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny Depp is an American actor, producer and musician known for his film roles and turbulent personal life. Despite set backs. Depp has remained active in the arts, marking a comeback on the international stage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍妮佛·羅培茲:三重威脅
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進珍妮花露柏絲的世界,她是娛樂事業的主導人物,從卑微出身到成為一線明星的歷程大大地鼓舞人心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the world of Jennifer Lopez, a dominant figure in the entertainment industry whose journey from humble beginnings to A-list stardom is nothing short of inspirational.

epg.programme_title_en: John Cena: Champion Of The Ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊先拿在繼巨石強森- 狄維莊遜後轉戰好萊塢之前,叱吒摔角界十多年.無論是演戲還是摔跤,他都遵守自己的座右銘:努力,忠誠,尊重.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John Cena dominated wrestling for over a decade before transitioning to Hollywood, following Dwayne The Rock Johnson. Whether acting or wrestling, he lives by his mantra: Hustle, Loyalty, and Respect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到託斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之旅的下一站是位於卡拉哈裡沙漠中心的提斯瓦魯豪華私人野生動物保護區.然後他遇到名廚馬努斯,烹製一些刺激的南非美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往沿海城市德班 - 住在標誌性的蠔盒酒店.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he’s staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在德班,華倫先到訪著名的麥士生活品味餐廳,享受任性的祖魯烤肉體驗,再與當地導遊浮高碰面,參觀附近一條祖魯村莊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max’s Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫美食之行的下一站是克魯格國家公園,南非其中一個最大的野生動物保護區,他住在著名的沙比沙比旅館.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren’s next stop on his food trail is Kruger National Park, one of South Africa’s largest game reserves, where he’s staying at the renowned Sabi Sabi lodge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在喀拉哈裡沙漠的中心發現無數的非洲動物,並學習製作傳統麵包乾來配早晨咖啡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Kalahari Desert, Warren spots a myriad of African animals, and learns to make traditional rusks to go with his morning coffee.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫來到歷史名城普利托利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren stops off at the historic city of Pretoria, where he visits the local farmers markets and cooks Koeksisters - South African sticky donuts - with Pastry Chef Nonkosi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰尼斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮.導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車 遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren is in the bustling city of Johannesburg, and his first stop is the vibrant township of Soweto. He’s taken on a tuk tuk tour by his guide Sindi, and cooks up his version of Chakalala, a South African vegetable relish.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努前往香港,這是他環球之旅的第四個國度,當然亦安排了一些極品美食之旅.雞腳,添好運,掃街以及許多適合他去日本東京前的適應活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu heads to Hong Kong, the fourth country on his around the world tour, and he has some great food excursions lined up. Chicken feet, Tim Ho Wan, street food and lots to fit in before he jumps across the pond to Tokyo, Japan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #5
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努的環球之旅已過一半,他前往探索繁華的東京.這是一個巨大的挑戰,因為在他正享受的同時,預算還有多少呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Manu heads past his halfway mark on his journey around the world, he heads to Tokyo to explore the bustling city. It is a massive challenge and he is having the time of his life but how is that budget going?

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是最後衝刺,馬努的名單只剩下一個國家.美國作為他冒險的最後一站提供了令人驚嘆的美食體驗.環遊世界.三十天.花費20,000美元.馬努能夢想成真嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is the home stretch with just one more country on Manus list. America offers amazing food experiences on his final leg of his adventure. Around the world. Thirty days. $20,000 to spend. Will Manu achieve his dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his fathers side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉.他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mothers family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫前往開普酒鄉,品嚐一系列當地的葡萄酒,包括南非標誌性紅酒皮諾塔吉和獨特而複雜的加烈葡萄酒華塔菲亞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努前往香港,這是他環球之旅的第四個國度,當然亦安排了一些極品美食之旅.雞腳,添好運,掃街以及許多適合他去日本東京前的適應活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Manu heads to Hong Kong, the fourth country on his around the world tour, and he has some great food excursions lined up. Chicken feet, Tim Ho Wan, street food and lots to fit in before he jumps across the pond to Tokyo, Japan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #5
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬努的環球之旅已過一半,他前往探索繁華的東京.這是一個巨大的挑戰,因為在他正享受的同時,預算還有多少呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As Manu heads past his halfway mark on his journey around the world, he heads to Tokyo to explore the bustling city. It is a massive challenge and he is having the time of his life but how is that budget going?

epg.programme_title_tc: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Around The World With Manu Feildel #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是最後衝刺,馬努的名單只剩下一個國家.美國作為他冒險的最後一站提供了令人驚嘆的美食體驗.環遊世界.三十天.花費20,000美元.馬努能夢想成真嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is the home stretch with just one more country on Manus list. America offers amazing food experiences on his final leg of his adventure. Around the world. Thirty days. $20,000 to spend. Will Manu achieve his dream?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態.從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal’s diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海.探索成年雄鹿,青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs spring rituals, and Grebes dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夜間追蹤任務到救援行動,了解MH-6小鳥直昇機如何在其他大型機體中贏得一席之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From night stalker missions to rescue operations, see how the Little Bird helicopter earned its place among the big boys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到託斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called 「bubble feeding」 to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量.這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, Little penguin Snapper returns to the colony but will he be accepted? The vet team prepare to treat Samantran tiger Sali, and the Zoo helps to save an endangered native species at risk.

Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Dogs are mans’ most loyal friends. Their well-behaved and cute appearance is very soothing to our hearts. That’s why many people choose dogs to company with their family! There are many choices for companion dogs, but today's cute pet have well-developed muscles and a fierce look on their faces. But in fact, they love to act cute, making the contrast between their personality and appearance is extremely cute!
Today's Cute Pet Coming is going to subvert everyone’s impression on them! Follow us and get to know bulldogs ​​with a fierce face and gentle heart!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to  Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!
